metadata.title: 게임수학 Part 2 · 3D 회전 ① 방향과 회전 행렬
metadata.description:
같은 방향을 보는데 몸이 기울어지는 이유는 무엇일까요? 이번 시간에는 게임 속 비행을 보며 방향과 자세를 구분합니다. 세 좌표축으로 회전 행렬을 만들고, 로컬 좌표를 월드 좌표로 바꿔 봅니다. 마지막으로 역변환과 잘못된 회전을 검사하고, 두 문제를 직접 풀며 부호와 계산 순서까지 확인하겠습니다.

Superflight의 비행, Descenders의 자전거, Trailmakers의 조립 비행기, Space Engineers의 부품 배치를 연결해 같은 자세 표현 원리를 비교합니다.

englishMetadata.title: Game Math Part 2 · 3D Rotation 1: Orientation and Rotation Matrices
englishMetadata.description:
Why can an object tilt while facing the same direction? We will observe flight in a game and distinguish direction from orientation. Then we will build a rotation matrix from three axes and convert local coordinates into world coordinates. Finally, we will check inverse transforms and invalid rotations, then solve two problems to verify the signs and calculation order.

We connect flight in Superflight, bicycle orientation in Descenders, an assembled aircraft in Trailmakers and component placement in Space Engineers to compare the same representation of orientation.

📚 Game Math PART2 course materials
YamYamWiki · Game Math PART2
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/1ea0b1ff-a61e-803f-bd54-cac4f028f6b3

YamYamCoding website
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/

YamYamWiki course notes
https://www.yamyamcoding.com/0d2adf45-5d1a-43be-a37c-61c94b1ae2c8

A full Game Math Part2 lecture with40% actual gameplay and60% explanation, narrated without background music.

03:57 Read body axes in a world frame
04:09 Fix column vectors and transform direction
04:42 Calculate a 90-degree rotation
05:19 Read an aircraft nose and wings together
05:53 Local forward and world direction
06:41 Axis components and the transpose
06:55 Why inverse rotation uses the transpose
07:31 Direction cosines as dot products
08:09 From aircraft orientation to component placement

09:22 Compose nested orientations
09:54 Check lengths and right angles first
10:09 Two conditions for a proper rotation
10:42 Rotation versus apparent stretching
11:29 Reject reflection and scaling
12:07 Remove a parallel component
12:22 Small errors and matrix drift
13:01 Visible flight and internal calculations
13:48 Nine stored values and memory
14:25 Name transform direction in code
15:01 The frame used by game commands
15:36 Validate intermediate orientations too
15:50 Why mixing matrix entries can collapse
16:21 Two worked problems
16:56 Read orientation during flight
17:46 Three things to remember
18:08 Membership thanks and programming coaching
